name: Athletes
overview: Scripture uses the imagery of athletes to illustrate the strength and endurance that come from reliance on the Lord. Isaiah 40:31 emphasizes that those who wait on God will have renewed strength, enabling them to run without weariness and walk without fainting. This divine empowerment is echoed in Philippians 4:13, where believers are reminded that through Christ's strength, they can face all challenges. Jeremiah 29:11 further assures that God's plans for His people are filled with hope and a purposeful future, encouraging perseverance in the Christian race.
